newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs focusing on 10-yr JGB auction result.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs focusing on 10-yr JGB auction result.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: no operation

*JGBs focusing on 10-year JGB auction to be held without participation of scandal-tainted Nomura Securities and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank, both of which held large shares in syndicate. *Bank of Japan's tankan due out on Wednesday. *Prime Minister Hashimoto's overnight remark on Japanese holdings of U.S. bonds unlikely affect JGBs.
